newsitem.title: USA: Dillon Read joined by insurance experts.
newsitem.headline: Dillon Read joined by insurance experts.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Dillon, Read & Co said Friday that it has been joined by a group of senior corporate finance and equity research professionals with deep experience in the insurance industry.
The group, previously affiliated with Dean Witter Discover & Co, includes three investment bankers and three research analysts, Dillon, Read said.
The corporate finance staff will be based in Chicago, Dillon, Read said.
The firm said that the addition of this team underscores its committment to the insurance industry as a sector in which it expects to increase its activities "significantly" in the coming months.
